11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

1305|9f005af4.name: Jarel Moor
1305|9f005af4.text: Take my advice, don't sit close to the shadows.

269152|644ccfaa.name: Tylana Clawhoof
269152|644ccfaa.text: You are not known to my people.  A kodo is a mighty steed, and it is the product of love and care by my people; such is not given onto strangers.  Until the elders of Thunder Bluff consider you to be exalted, I cannot offer you the sale of a kodo.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

461|86b6c1ef.name: Demisette Cloyce
461|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

461|8fca8484.name: Demisette Cloyce
461|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1087-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-progress.text: Here, channeling magic is like drawing water from a well with a bucket full of holes.
1087-progress.title: Cenarius' Legacy

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

1716-accept.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1716-accept.text:
A sayaad is a devourer of souls, dominator of wills, and tempter of hearts. It knows nothing but evil.

Salacious tales refer to the demon by its common name: succubus for females, incubus for males.

A stimulus is required to beckon the creature. With a symbol of love as bait, it will surely answer your call. Defeat it, and make it your tool.

It will be hard to find a thing of this nature, though. You should speak with Takar the Seer. You will find him in the Barrens of Kalimdor near Camp Taurajo.
1716-accept.title: Devourer of Souls

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth
